title: Flex Item Overflow vs min-width: 0 Sandbox
description: Observe how the default min-width: auto prevents a flex item from shrinking below its unbreakable min-content width.

'YES (' + (row.scrollWidth - row.clientWidth) + 'px)' : 'NONE'); }
expectedObservation: With min-width: 0 disabled, even flex-shrink: 1 cannot compress the main column below its unbreakable child's intrinsic width, causing horizontal overflow past the red dashed container boundary. Enabling min-width: 0 lifts that floor so text-overflow: ellipsis engages.
